item.title: Gulls Late Rally Not Enough to Beat Barracuda
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the San Jose Barracuda tonight after a late rally was not enough to take over the lead at Tech CU Arena, 3-2. Tomas Suchanek took over in the crease early in the first period after Calle Clang made an early departure from the game. Suchanek faced 26 total shots, allowing only two through to keep San Diego in the game. The Barracuda found three goals before the Gulls were able to put some pressure on in the third period. item.title: Gulls Finish Short of IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls fell to the Rockford IceHogs tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 3-2. item.title: Carpenter Shines in Gulls Victory Over IceHogs
item.description: By Ashley Rubin/SanDiegoGulls.com The San Diego Gulls found their redemption and defeated the Rockford IceHogs tonight at Pechanga Arena San Diego, 6-4. Tonight’s victory was essential for the Gulls. A three-game losing streak was broken and the team brings themselves to 62 points, which holds their sixth-position spot in the Pacific Division standings.
